excerpt: A data set of proton-proton collisions at sqrt(s) = 13.6 TeV collected by SND@LHC in 2022 is used, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 36.8 fb-1. ... eight neutrino interaction candidate events are observed with a background of 0.076 (0.15) events, resulting in a significance of 7 (6.8) standard deviations.
title: Observation of Collider Muon Neutrinos with the SND@LHC Experiment
